diagnosis.root_cause: R64 DrawDest eagerly calls ID3DXSprite::Flush on each exact GOAL Draw even when the same homogeneous queue-owned producer has already armed a safe BeforeQueueNode/BeforeQueueEnd submission boundary; this fragments glyph batches into extra GPU submissions.
source_trace: Original hooked ResultProgress / GoalTime020 / GoalTime150 / OutRunStagePrintf producers emit scoped queued D3DX Draws.
R64 DrawDest increments PendingDraws and kept eager Flush even though clean queued owner stayed live.
R64 BeforeQueueNode and BeforeQueueEnd synchronously FlushTracked before SelectSpriteQueueNode/EndSpriteQueueRender and R84 uses same explicit ScreenHud owner for both eyes.
alternatives_rejected: Global Flush removal would defer unknown or direct buffers to unsafe GPU owners; exact source, active queue and live batch evidence are all prerequisites.
